relationship: Prime-factor copy counts determine HCF through shared minimum counts and LCM through combined maximum counts.

learnerLoop.action: Build prime-factor rows, pair matching copies and compare their counts.
learnerLoop.modelChange: Pairs and remaining prime copies are classified for HCF and LCM.
learnerLoop.evidence: Factor rows, pair markers and count summaries reveal the two products.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Pair another common prime or certify that no pair remains.

invariants: Only identical prime copies can form a common pair.
HCF uses minimum exponents and LCM uses maximum exponents.
safeAdaptations: Use other composite-number pairs with visible prime-copy accounting.
Vary working support without hiding the minimum-versus-maximum comparison.
nonGoals: Finding HCF or LCM from unstructured factor lists without prime multiplicities.
